title: Data Provider Decision Log

notes: File lives in a 'decisions/' directory and is framed as a decision log, giving it ADR-like signals, but Status is explicitly 'Open' (not Accepted/Proposed) and the document repeatedly states it is 'Not a final recommendation document' and 'Explicitly not decided here.'
